subject: General Aptitude: Analytical Aptitude
questionTextRaw: Six people are seated around a circular table. There are at least two men and two women. There are at least three right-handed persons. Every woman has a left-handed person to her immediate right. None of the women are right-handed. The number of women at the table is A.                                                                               B. C.                                                                               D. Cannot be determined
